decisions.reason: Removing Big Block draws necessarily narrows winner eligibility to Small Block tickets and makes the Big Block eligibility-cohort attribute obsolete; the remaining Chainlink VRF selection behavior is unchanged.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey [FREELANCER_NAME_001], I’d like to remove the big blocks and redirect that extra $1 to me, making the split:
$15 buy, $5 to me, $5 to affiliate, $5 to block prize pool.

This improves my bottom line while having minimal effect on sales.
It also makes the game mechanics and marketing simpler.

An even split between me and every community member, together with everyone having an equal chance at the never-ending $500 prizes, seems consistent with the project’s ethos.

value_updates.eligible_population: current holders of active Small Block prize tickets, including secondary buyers who receive active tickets with the NFT

decisions.reason: The existing message-195 MODIFY already captures the necessary consequence that secondary royalties fund only the remaining Small Block prize pool. The source does not necessarily change the $10 royalty structure or explicitly redirect an additional secondary-sale dollar to the founder.
